about_the_game:
You've finally reached the Terminus. But the true final step for survival still lies ahead.

Last Escape is the first major DLC for Terminus: Zombie Survivors, depicting a new chapter unfolding after your arrival at the end of the line. As supplies dwindle under the unceasing threat of zombie attack, a daring escape plan begins—a plan that could determine the fate of all survivors.

The Story Beyond the Terminus

The Terminus was not the end of the journey. It has become a temporary refuge, and now, you must secure it, rescue the city's last citizens, and take on new survival scenarios. Continue your story by exploring the newly opened, large-scale areas: Inside the Terminus and The Platform.

  • Rescue endangered civilians throughout the city.

  • Take on a variety of quests Inside the Terminus and on The Platform.

  • Prove yourself as a valuable member of the survivor community through quest progression.

Bonds with the Survivors

The survivors at the Terminus each have their own backstories and unique abilities. Some are responsible for defending the station, while others manage food supplies and medical support. Talk to them, learn their stories, and lend your aid.

  • Discover hidden stories and past events through conversations.

  • Complete character-specific quests to build trust and earn special rewards.

  • Collect unique items and gear provided by survivors.

New Ending: Escape by Train

Restore the railway and board the train to escape the city. This new ending delivers a dramatic and dangerous final challenge. Face the ultimate escape from a city overrun by zombies aboard a moving train.

  • Rescue the train engineer and recover essential components to operate the train.

  • Fight fierce battles to reclaim the train platform from zombies.

  • Overcome relentless threats and start the engine to leave the city behind.

Experience a gripping, post-terminus storyline with fellow survivors, and make your Last Escape a success.

Now, your true survival story begins.
